title: Add Notion database rows with AI from your approved notes
h1: turn a clear request into a notion database row
description: Ask a bot to create a Notion database row with matching properties and a short page body. Check database access and avoid unsupported multi-source targets.
keyword: notion add database row with ai
keywords: ai turn notes into notion rows
answer: a bot can create a new page inside a notion database, filling the properties you specify and adding short content blocks to its body. give it the database reference and field meanings first. the database must be shared with the connection and have only one data source; creating the row is a write that does not automatically ask before proceeding.
og_line: your notes, in the right database fields.
what:
each row is also a notion page. properties hold the table fields, while child blocks hold the longer description inside that page. paste the database link; the bot looks at its columns before filling one in.

keep the first entry small. long text segments in child blocks may be shortened, and extra blocks are appended after the page is created. a created row is therefore not proof that every paragraph arrived. this action adds a new row rather than updating an existing one.
uses: record a confirmed equipment purchase in the purchasing database
turn a single accepted research proposal into a row with its short brief inside
add a workshop booking once the date and organiser are confirmed
save an idea with its source note while leaving undecided properties empty

routine.message: every thursday at 12:35, take the purchase decisions i explicitly approved in this chat this week for thistledown theatre. prepare rows for the notion purchasing database i linked, matching its existing property names, and show them here before creating anything. once i agree, insert the rows and include a short body note with the decision source. never guess costs, update existing rows or retry an uncertain creation without checking for a duplicate.
routine.needs: notion connected, with read and write access; the single-source database shared with the connection
routine.output:
thistledown theatre purchase preview
item: portable lectern
approval note: accepted by hedda paulsen in this chat
cost: not provided, left empty
waiting before creating a notion row.

steps: connect notion through **Connected apps** and share the intended database with the connection.
allow **read and write** for row creation, narrowing the bot to the insertion and inspection actions it needs.
have it inspect the database and map one short example to the actual properties before permitting an insert.
read the new row and its body, then use **Pause** on the routine card if text or fields are missing.
watch: databases with several data sources are not supported by this insert action.
long child-block text may be truncated, and appended blocks can fail after the page already exists.
adding a row doesn't ask you first. put "ask me first" in the routine if you want to check each one.

faq.q: is a database row different from a notion page?
faq.a: the inserted row is a page within the selected database. its properties appear in the table and its child blocks form the page body.

faq.q: will it replace a row with the same title?
faq.a: this is an insert action. do not rely on it to update or deduplicate matching titles; check existing entries before retrying.
